question: Which of the following is NOT a p block element of the periodic table?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Magnesium**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Magnesium **is not a p-block element of the periodic table.**
 
• The **p-block elements are groups 13–18 of the periodic table, with the exception of helium.**
 
• Magnesium **is an s-block element, as it belongs to group 2. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Phosphorus:**

 
 
• A non-metal that is essential for life and is a key component of DNA, RNA, ATP, and cell membranes
 
 
 
• **Iodine**
 
 
• It belongs to the **halogen group (Group 17)** of the periodic table, which includes other non-metals like fluorine, chlorine, bromine, and astatine. 
 
 
 
• **Silicon**
 
 
• It is classified as a **metalloid**.
 
• Metalloids are elements that have properties intermediate between metals and non-metals.
 
• Silicon is a perfect example of this category.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• Here are some other elements and their blocks:
 
• **Germanium:**
 
 
• A p-block element that is a lustrous, hard, greyish-white metalloid 
 
 
 
• **Manganese:**
 
 
• A d-block element that is often found in minerals in combination with iron 
 
 
 
• **Technetium: **
 
 
• **​**A d-block element that is the lightest element whose isotopes are all radioactive 
 
 
 
• **Rhenium: **
 
 
• **​**A d-block element that is a silvery-white, heavy, third-row transition metal 
 
 
 
• **Halogens:**
 
 
• A group of five elements (fluorine, chlorine, bromine, iodine, and astatine) that are p-block elements
